## Security verdict: PASS WITH NOTES

PR #200, exact head `87f7f8b19f8e138a2207165ed5a88c035bc85b36`. Final delta review from `633f43a`, graded under current C33/C34.

| # | Severity | File | Lines | Vulnerability | Confidence |
|---|----------|------|-------|---------------|------------|
| - | - | - | - | No new in-scope vulnerability or normal-use blocker identified | - |

The seat upsert checks owner-close in its own SQL statement. Ordinary puts that would clear/change that tombstone affect zero rows and return E-RS-SEAT-RETIRED; the surrounding uncommitted transaction rolls back its event (`crates/store/src/registry.rs:344-430,527-610`). Registration translates that refusal to the rendered retired response; only explicit launch/revive placement and verified reclaim use the lifting write (`crates/daemon/src/http/mod.rs:1599-1610`; `crates/daemon/src/registration.rs:1215-1243`; `crates/store/src/role_assertion.rs:233-287`).

Closing an observed-dead/reaped seat now records owner-close; only an already owner-closed repeat returns the existing receipt (`crates/daemon/src/http/lifecycle.rs:427-447`). No new raw-reason rendering or C19/C21 disclosure was identified.

**C34 follow-up:** F151, the stated predecessor-supersede edge and pre-change custom reasons remain Known limits. Prior marker/pane-advice qualifications stand. No extra fixtures or mutation runs are required by this verdict.
